items.claim: Judice outstruck both of her opponents in her two career losses.
items.quote: The two decisions that she lost, I mean, she out struck both of her opponents there.

items.claim: Chavez fights out of either stance and comes forward with high volume.
items.quote: She's going to come forward with and fight out of either stance. ... Tons of volume.

items.claim: Chavez has strong durability and can take a punch well.
items.quote: Girl could take a punch. She's tough.

items.claim: Chavez has effective Muay Thai skills in the clinch and good ground and pound from top position.
items.quote: Gets a hold of you in the tie clinch. She's going to slam knees and elbows. ... On the mat, if she's on top, she's got good ground and pound

items.claim: Chavez is extremely weak when fighting off her back on the ground.
items.quote: off her back, she's got nothing. Just nothing at all.

items.claim: GDS possesses strong cardio, good takedown defense, and the ability to work back to her feet.
items.quote: she's got good cardio. She can keep the fight on the feet, good takedown defense, works back to her feet

items.claim: GDS has high-volume striking with great combinations and punch-kick transitions.
items.quote: the striking is beautiful. Solid striking, good combinations, put her punch puts her punches and kicks together extremely well. Very high volume.

items.claim: Wes Schultz has decent striking without much power.
items.quote: decent striking. He didn't have anything in the way of power

items.claim: Wes Schultz has the ability to mix in a variety of kicks to all levels.
items.quote: he does have really good ability to mix in a variety of kicks, and he can do it to all levels.
